item.title: Reizoku no Majo April ~Injoku no Mahou Choukyou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Aconite
  • 発売日: 2011-04-28
  • スコア: 5.59/10 (625 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 隷属の魔女エイプリル～淫辱の魔法調教～
  • 英語名: Reizoku no Majo April Injoku no Mahou Choukyou

别名

  • Reizoku no Majo April Injoku no Mahou Choukyou

あらすじ

In order to become a magician, Denis enters an apprenticeship under the famous, beautiful witch April, only to be overworked and abused on a daily basis. He bears with his hatred for her as he devotes himself to studying her techniques until one day, he discovers Maisie, a fairy April had sealed away.

あらすじ

Himeko, who woke up in an unfamiliar house, met a boy in a similar situation, Koichi, and decided to seek out the criminals who locked her in here. However, what awaited such two people was the atrocious trap set by the lord of the hall. Koichi scolds and crawls on Himeko who is about to be attacked by a nanimono, and will bear the bruise of death. “The boy’s life is three hours later …. If you want to live and get out of here, look for the three hidden keys in this hall. ”Himeko believes in information that can be said to be the only clue, and starts searching the inside of the hall where nanimonos crawl. Is it salvation to be waiting for her? Or …
